ios.desc:
PREACH+ is built for preachers, teachers, and ministry leaders who want one focused place to study Scripture, prepare sermons, organize their message, and preach.

Study Scripture with tools designed for sermon preparation. Explore related verses, commentary, historical and cultural context, Greek and Hebrew word studies, Bible maps, biblical characters, timelines, and other resources that help you understand the passage more deeply.

When you’re ready to prepare your message, PREACH+ gives you flexible ways to work. Bring in an existing sermon, organize your material with structured blocks, or build a new sermon from the beginning.

AI-assisted tools can help organize sermon material, strengthen wording, improve clarity, and assist with study and preparation while keeping you in control of the final message.

When it’s time to preach, Preach Mode presents your sermon in a clean, focused format designed for the pulpit.

PREACH+ also includes an offline Bible and Bible Notes, so Scripture reading and personal Bible notes remain available without a Premium subscription.

PREACH+ Premium unlocks advanced Study tools, sermon preparation, AI-assisted features, Preach Mode, sermon cloud synchronization, PDF, printing, sharing, and other Premium features.

Whether you’re studying a passage, developing a sermon, or standing behind the pulpit, PREACH+ is designed around one purpose:

Study. Prepare. Preach. Make an Impact.
